verdict.rationale: Unreal ships its own 2D system, Paper 2D, which provides sprites as texture-mapped planar meshes plus Tile Sets and Tile Maps for painting 2D levels. However, the sprite page cited is UE4.27 documentation, and the UE 5.8 tile map page carries an "Experimental" banner advising caution when shipping. The physics evidence (Chaos) describes a general 3D rigid-body solver with no dedicated 2D physics, which supports the "3D afterthought" framing rather than first-class 2D. Missing for 10: dedicated 2D physics, production-ready (non-experimental) tilemaps, current UE5 sprite documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration that 2D is a first-class workflow.
